**2.8h**

I started by moving the drop thing so it would fall on the plinko, the obstacle rectangle thing. I did this by creating 2-3 new planes and moving the sketch, then i made a bigger track for the exit of the plinko so the marble wouldnt get stuck and connected it to a staircase that i also made. ### 2026-10-18 – I started by fixing some errors and connecting tracks so they would come printed as the same, then I made some supports since i needed the part to be more expensive to be printed, then I researched ho

**1.8h**

I started by fixing some errors and connecting tracks so they would come printed as the same, then I made some supports since i needed the part to be more expensive to be printed, then I researched how to export the project, made a github repo, made the Readme and also uploaded the step file, then i started making the BOM and researched some sites, i ended up with 3, one the result was 150 dollars, the other didnt even let me print, the third didnt let any order below 45 bucks, so the cost of the project ended up being 77 dollars, because of IVA (taxes) and shipping.
